factcheck.claim: Plans as of Oct 2026: Free 100 tasks/mo two-step Zaps; Professional from $19.99/mo annual ($29.99 monthly) for 750 tasks; Team from $69/mo annual ($103.50 monthly) for 2,000 tasks; Enterprise custom
Each successful action counts as a task; triggers and polling are free; failed/halted actions are free
Built-in tools that do not count as tasks: Tables, Forms, Filter, Formatter, Paths, Delay, Looping, Sub-Zap, Digest, Zapier Manager, Storage
Pay-per-task: billed at higher per-task rate, capped at 3x plan task limit (Pro 750 → 2,250), not available on Free; exact rate shown in Billing settings
One Zapier MCP tool call uses two tasks; AI by Zapier usage depends on model tier
Polling time Free 15 min / Professional 2 min / Team 1 min; Team 25 users, shared Zaps and app connections; upgrades immediate and prorated
Pay-per-task overage rate: 1.25x normal per-task cost on annual plans, 2.5x on monthly plans (Zapier's own blog); exact rate in Billing settings

Help Center article title is 'How is task usage measured in Zapier?' and defines a task as 'any successful action that runs in Zapier'; pay-per-task article title is 'How pay-per-task billing works in Zapier'

variables.headline_finding: Naive step count (2,130) overestimates billed tasks (820) by 2.6x for three typical solo Zaps — the gap between the $89 (5,000) and $39 (1,500) Professional annual tier
variables.worked_example: A lead form 5 steps x 300 runs (200 pass Filter) = 400 tasks; B Stripe 3 steps x 150 = 300; C invoice email 3 steps x 60 = 120; total 820
variables.filter_savings: Filter right after trigger drops 100 junk runs in workflow A → 200 fewer billed tasks than with no filter (600 → 400)
variables.cost_per_task: Professional annual: 2.7c at 750, 2.6c at 1,500, 2.5c at 2,000, 1.8c at 5,000, 1.3c at 10,000 (computed from official list prices)
variables.free_plan_structure: Free = two-step only, so free Filter/Formatter steps cannot be used to save tasks there — every fired trigger becomes a billed task
variables.competitor_errors: nocode.mba 5-step x 150 = 750 and activepieces '3-step = 3 tasks' both count the trigger; eesel 10,000 tasks ~$300 vs official $129
